# Simply Charlotte Mason

> A comprehensive homeschool curriculum resource built on Charlotte Mason's educational philosophy emphasizing living books, habit formation, and nature study across all grade levels.

Simply Charlotte Mason provides free, pre-planned curriculum guides and educational resources for homeschooling families following the Charlotte Mason method. The site offers grade-level specific lesson plans from preschool through 12th grade, along with foundational philosophy and approach documentation.

## Key Topics

- Charlotte Mason Method
- homeschool curriculum
- living books
- habit formation
- classical education
- homeschool planning
- play-based learning
- language arts
- daily schedule
- family lessons
- curriculum guide
- nature study
- character development
- high school schedule
- individual lessons

## Core Philosophy & Approach

- [Charlotte Mason method homeschool curriculum and helps](https://simplycharlottemason.com): Homepage for Simply Charlotte Mason homeschool curriculum and resources.
- [What is the Charlotte Mason Method? - Simply Charlotte Mason](https://simplycharlottemason.com/what-is-the-charlotte-mason-method): Explains Charlotte Mason method philosophy and three-pronged approach.
- [Our Approach - Simply Charlotte Mason](https://simplycharlottemason.com/our-approach): Simply Charlotte Mason's curriculum approach using habits, books, discovery.
- [Which Homeschool Style Should I Use?](https://simplycharlottemason.com/five-homeschooling-styles): Compare homeschooling styles and take assessment quiz to find your approach.

## Curriculum Planning & Overview

- [Simply Charlotte Mason Curriculum Overview - Simply Charlotte Mason](https://simplycharlottemason.com/planning/curriculum-guide/overview-chart): Complete curriculum overview chart for all grade levels.
